resumen_enfoque: Estimated 2125 kcal/day for hypertrophy, with 136 g of protein as the priority. It's a starting point that gets adjusted based on real weight and energy over the first few weeks.
distribucion_comidas: Divide this across 4 meals, each one with some protein in it. How you split it is flexible — the only thing that matters is that it actually fits your day.
consejos_sinergias: Vitamins D, E, K and omega-3s are absorbed better when taken with the day's meal with the most healthy fat (never on an empty stomach).
mensaje_para_el_cliente: Hi Marta, this is your diet draft. Think amounts and context, not forbidden foods — nothing here is off the table. What matters is whether it holds up three months from now, not just this week. If something doesn't fit your life, say so and we'll swap it for an equivalent.
